notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Various Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
After completely reworking a lot of under-the-hood stuff it's finally time for the first patch.

[list]
[*]Fixed issue where players randomly got stuck when starting a new training.
[*]Fixed issue where player controls stayed disabled under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed issue where players could leave a level during an active training sequence.
[*]Added build version number to options menu.
[*]Fixed some typos in dialogues.
[*]Fixed special characters not displaying correctly in credits.
[*]Added some missing backers to the credits.
[*]Other small fixes.
[*]Updated demo.
[/list]
